success_patterns: Heading & Snippet Prioritization: Quickly scan document titles ([TLE]) and opening snippets for exact phrase matches or direct paraphrases of trivia/Jeopardy clues before reading full paragraphs.
Adaptive Reasoning Depth: Skip lengthy step-by-step deduction when the answer is explicitly stated or strongly implied in the context; reserve reasoning only for ambiguous or multi-hop queries.

patch.reasoning: Successful trajectories consistently leverage document titles and snippets for rapid answer extraction on trivia and Jeopardy-style questions. They also adapt their reasoning depth based on answer clarity, avoiding unnecessary deduction when the context provides a direct match. Encoding these patterns will improve retrieval speed, reduce token waste, and prevent over-complication of straightforward extraction tasks.

edits.content: - **Heading & Snippet Prioritization**: For trivia and Jeopardy-style queries, scan document titles (`[TLE]`) and opening snippets first. These often contain the exact answer or direct paraphrase. Use them to anchor your search before diving into full paragraphs.
